# find_super_connectors { #dyf.find_super_connectors }

```python
find_super_connectors(
    embeddings,
    global_num_bits=12,
    facet_num_bits=10,
    dense_percentile=75,
    global_threshold_percentile=50,
    local_threshold_percentile=50,
    min_bucket_size=20,
    seed=42,
)
```

Find super connectors: points with high centrality in both global and local
bridge networks.

Super connectors are ideal RAG anchor points because they:
- Bridge across major semantic regions (high global centrality)
- Connect facets within dense clusters (high local centrality)
- Provide 10x better coverage efficiency than random anchors

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                        | Type                                     | Description                             | Default    |
|-----------------------------|------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|------------|
| embeddings                  | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | Normalized embeddings (n_points, dim)   | _required_ |
| global_num_bits             | [int](`int`)                             | LSH bits for global bucketing           | `12`       |
| facet_num_bits              | [int](`int`)                             | LSH bits for facet bucketing            | `10`       |
| dense_percentile            | [float](`float`)                         | Percentile threshold for dense buckets  | `75`       |
| global_threshold_percentile | [float](`float`)                         | Percentile for "high" global centrality | `50`       |
| local_threshold_percentile  | [float](`float`)                         | Percentile for "high" local centrality  | `50`       |
| min_bucket_size             | [int](`int`)                             | Minimum bucket size for faceting        | `20`       |
| seed                        | [int](`int`)                             | Random seed                             | `42`       |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                   | Description                                           |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [SuperConnectorResult](`dyf.rag.SuperConnectorResult`) | SuperConnectorResult with indices and centrality data |
